note: Registry of the four protected shop products. The IDs are immutable: a record with one of these slugs, SKUs or legacy IDs is always stored under its registry ID. Identity (id, slug, name, category, a confirmed SKU) can only change by editing this file in source control; Admin, imports, sync and scripts cannot change it, delete the product, deactivate it or archive it. Price, MRP, stock, text and images stay editable in Admin with a reason, and every change is logged with before/after values. 'restore' is used only when a product is missing everywhere (no snapshot, no backup). See docs/unified/PROTECTED-PRODUCTS.md.

sources.identity: frontend/products/<slug>.html — the live product pages (cart id = slug, name and price in the Add to Cart button, MRP on the page)
sources.sku: src/seed.js — the demo catalogue the shop was first filled from; to be confirmed by the owner
sources.hsnCode: not found in the code, the price list or the invoice — to be confirmed by the owner
sources.gstRate: not found in the code, the price list or the invoice — to be confirmed by the owner
